raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / PIANO TERRA ESCLUSIVO | OASI CON PISCINA A JESOLO FOR SALE · APARTMENT Piano Terra Esclusivo | Oasi con Piscina a Jesolo PIAZZA NEMBER · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €420,000 Photos (20) Floor plans (0) 1 / 20 FLOOR AREA 75 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo! Nestled in the reserved and exclusive atmosphere of a residence designed as a true oasis of relaxation, this ground floor apartment represents the perfect blend of independence, comfort, and outdoor living. Enhancing the complex is an extraordinary swimming pool, a perfect setting for those seeking moments of pure relaxation in a private and exclusive context. The property stands out for its layout between indoor and outdoor spaces. The bright and well-proportioned living room with kitchenette opens directly onto a splendid covered porch: a true extension of the living area outdoors, ideal for lunches and moments of relaxation, flowing into the spacious exclusive courtyard. A second porch and an additional private courtyard at the back ensure privacy and multiple areas to enjoy at any time of day. The sleeping area is thoughtfully distributed around a central hallway that carefully separates the privacy of two large bedrooms while serving the master bathroom. Completing the exclusivity of this property is a convenient external accessory room, perfect as storage or service space. A unique dwelling designed for those seeking tranquility in their own private garden along with the exclusivity of an oasis with pool without sacrificing functionality from perfectly organized internal spaces.
